name: source_sun_search2_charge
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
lane=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/sun.pdf','-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'sources/sun.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
print(r.stdout[:23000])
p={'queries':['"Sun" "s_1(n)" "zero" "2026"','"plane-filling" "Conjecture 4.3" smooth','"digit sum" "Beierle" "conjecture" proof counterexample']};r=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'search-plan-2.json'],input=json.dumps(p),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(lane/'charge_search.py'),str(lane/'search-plan-2.json')],text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout);assert r.returncode==0
